title: Venetian Bronze Cabinet Pull, 3-Inch Solid Brass Cabinet-Mount Traditional Handle, 3.9 In Length, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Venetian Bronze, cabinet pull with 3-inch size, solid brass construction, and cabinet-mount installation for upgrading kitchen or bathroom cabinets and drawers, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. Overall dimensions: 3.9 in L x 1.6 in H x 0.9 in W with 1 in projection; supports up to 2 lb. Traditional style with contemporary design elements. Includes cabinet pull and all installation hardware; no assembly required. Designer finish options are offered for corrosion-free, rust-free performance, with a limited lifetime warranty. Pairs well with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Allied Brass decorative cabinet hardware.
